description: A long two-handed hammer for swatting things out of the air. A metre more reach than a warhammer.
name: Anti-air Hammer

description: Indirect fire at three hundred metres. Two actions to fire, two to reload.
name: Batkin Artillery

description: A bell-mouthed gun built for arms the size of a Carni's. Two actions to fire, two to reload.
name: Huge Blunderbuss

description: A rock, carried up and let go of. Gravity does the work.
name: Dropped Rock

description: A crew-served gun, carried into the fight on something bigger. Two actions to fire, two to reload.
name: Mounted Gun

description: A custom crossbow that fires TWICE before reloading. Fletcher's Co-op standard.
name: Double-Firing Crossbow

description: Goblin-forged gauntlets inlaid with goblin glass. 1d4+1 bludgeoning. Grappled targets are glued to your hands; wounds do not break your hold unless you choose. You may grapple targets whose stat is up to 2x the stat you grapple with.
name: Goblin Glass Gauntlets

description: A heater shield inlaid with goblin glass. Defense 4. Releases a cloud of obscuring smoke as a reaction when hit.
name: Goblin Glass Heater

description: A javelin inlaid with goblin glass. 1d8+1 at 14 m, slashing or piercing. Hostiles cannot pick them up — they turn slippery.
name: Goblin Glass Javelin

description: A longbow inlaid with goblin glass. 2d6+1 at 90 m. One die may be dealt as acid or fire.
name: Goblin Glass Longbow

description: A mattock inlaid with goblin glass. 1d8+1 at 3 m. The head shapes to your will between pick, piercing, splitting and slashing.
name: Goblin Glass Mattock

description: A morning star inlaid with goblin glass. 2d4+1+stat at 2 m. The head transforms at will between slashing, piercing and bludgeoning.
name: Goblin Glass Morning Star

description: Fine goblin steel inlaid with goblin glass, like gemstones. 2d4+1+Prowess piercing at 4 m — the head extends as it strikes.
name: Goblin Glass Spear

description: A five-metre lash of fire. It takes hold where it lands.
name: Fire Whip
